__comment: DelightfulCompat: the Delight mods split bread slices/toasts across c:foods/bread (Oak's, My Nether's) and c:bread_slices (More Delight), so e.g. More Delight's bread_slice didn't work in the 30 recipes that read c:foods/bread. Cross-populate the equivalent bread slices + toasts so any of them satisfies any bread recipe. required:false keeps absent mods safe.
